## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe what triggers the problem and what changes for the user.

## Verification

List the relevant checks you ran and their results. Note anything you could
not run and why. Include a screenshot for visible UI changes when useful.

## Review notes

Mention relevant limitations, dependency changes, or third-party attribution.
Use synthetic text in tests and screenshots. Do not include exported writing
logs, credentials, private documents, or other people's text.
